<section class="home-section">

    <h2>Research</h2>
    <div class="themes">
      <div class="theme">
        <h3>Social media and brand engagement</h3>
        <p>How consumers consume, contribute to and create brand-related content online, and what that does for brands.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="theme">
        <h3>Brands and consumer choice</h3>
        <p>Consumer-based brand equity, store brands, the need for uniqueness, global consumer culture and sustainable choices.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="theme">
        <h3>Digital behaviour and wellbeing</h3>
        <p>Gaming disorder and behavioural risks online, studied with psychometric and machine-learning methods.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="theme">
        <h3>Measurement and methods</h3>
        <p>Scale development and structural equation modelling for survey-based research.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
